steps.en: Install it; on macOS/Linux it pulls in the OS input backend
steps.zh: 装上它；macOS/Linux 会顺带装好系统输入后端

steps.en: Save a cropped screenshot of the button you need, e.g. button.png
steps.zh: 把要点的按钮截一小张图存下来，比如 button.png

steps.en: Script it: find the button, then click and type
steps.zh: 写脚本：先找按钮，再点击、打字

steps.en: Screenshots the primary monitor and finds where your image matches
steps.zh: 截主屏，找出你那张图在屏幕上的位置

steps.en: Turns each call into native mouse/keyboard events (Win32, Cocoa, X11)
steps.zh: 把每个调用翻译成系统原生的鼠标键盘事件

steps.en: The focused window receives them exactly as if a person clicked and typed
steps.zh: 当前焦点窗口收到的，和真人点击打字一模一样

value.en: A GUI-only app gets driven by a script — no API, CLI or accessibility hooks needed
value.zh: 只有图形界面的软件也能被脚本操作，不需要它有 API 或命令行

sources: https://github.com/asweigart/pyautogui#readme (pip install pyautogui; Dependencies; Example Usage: click, write, locateCenterOnScreen('button.png'); focused-window note; primary-monitor note)
https://github.com/asweigart/pyautogui#how-does-pyautogui-work (Windows API via ctypes, Cocoa on macOS, Xlib on Linux)
https://github.com/asweigart/pyautogui/blob/master/setup.py (install_requires: pyobjc-core / pyobjc-framework-quartz on Darwin, python3-Xlib on Linux, pyscreeze)
